method: GitHub repository search through gh api (queries below, sorted by most recently updated), pool deduplicated by lower-cased full name per group, forks, archived repositories, templates, repositories in other frozen lists and excluded names or topics removed, the whole pool shuffled with the seed (mulberry32 Fisher-Yates over sorted names) before those exclusions, and the remaining repositories checked in that order until each group quota passed. No provider, package or keyword is searched for.
